judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`) and a new acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/turnUsage.acceptance.test.ts`), without making any implementation changes at all. `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` remains completely untouched, meaning `afterModelResponse` still receives only `lastUsage` and two of the candidate's own new tests will fail immediately. None of the type/signature updates, spec updates (`specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`), or `CHANGELOG.md` entries required by the acceptance criteria were performed. Additionally, the reference added tests directly to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` rather than creating separate `.lore` and `.acceptance.test.ts` files.
